name: pasteport
description: Paste images and files from your local clipboard into a remote terminal — the remote path lands in the prompt, ready for a CLI agent to read.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Pasteport only reads the clipboard and writes to the configured remote directory; the directory setting is machine-scoped, so an untrusted workspace cannot redirect it.

pasteport.remoteDir.markdownDescription: Absolute POSIX directory on the remote host where pasted files land. `~` is not expanded.

enumDescriptions: Currently equivalent to none; will adapt once TUI quoting behaviour is verified.
Single-quote paths that contain special characters, for use in a shell.
Insert paths verbatim, for TUI agents that do not parse shell syntax.
pasteport.quoting.description: How remote paths are quoted when inserted into the terminal.

pasteport.trailingSpace.description: Append a space after the inserted path so you can keep typing.

pasteport.confirmAboveSeconds.markdownDescription: Ask before transfers estimated to take longer than this many seconds, using the measured transfer rate. Set to `0` to never ask.

pasteport.ttlHours.markdownDescription: Age at which pasted files are removed from the remote host and the local staging directory. Set to `0` to disable cleanup.

pasteport.bracketedPaste.markdownDescription: Wrap the inserted path in bracketed paste markers (`ESC[200~` … `ESC[201~`). Off by default; compatibility across TUIs is unverified.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build
